'''Yin Metal Pig''' (辛亥, ''kanoto i''; onyomi ''shingai'') is the 48th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 48th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Metal Dog|ja|庚戌}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Water Rat|ja|壬子}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''辛'' is Yin Metal, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''亥'' (Pig) is Yin Water; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Metal Pig (辛亥)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): xīnhài
** Cantonese (Jyutping): san1 hoi6
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kanoto-i
*** On'yomi: shingai
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): sinhhae (신해)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Tân Hợi

==Months of Yin Metal Pig==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 2 or 7 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Mizunoe (壬)|ja|壬|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren}} or {{ill|Hinoto (丁)|ja|丁|lt=Hinoto (丁)|2=ja|3=丁|4=zh|5=丁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tei}}), the month of {{ill|October|en|October|qid=Q124|lt=October}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)}} of {{ill|Yin Metal Pig|ja|辛亥|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xinhai|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Lidong|en|Lidong|qid=Q1191018|lt=Beginning of Winter}} until the day before {{ill|Daxue (solar term)|en|Daxue (solar term)|qid=Q337815|lt=Heavy Snow}}) as applicable.
